description: This file contains implementations related to tensor creation and resizing specifically for the Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch. It includes functions for creating empty tensors, resizing tensors, setting storage, and allocating zero tensors within the MPS context.

methods.name: void maybe_resize_storage_mps(TensorImpl * self,uint64_t new_size)
methods.description: Resizes the storage of a tensor for MPS if needed, allocating new memory and copying existing data.

methods.name: TensorImpl * resize_impl_mps_(TensorImpl * self,IntArrayRef size,std::optional<IntArrayRef> stride,bool device_guard=true)
methods.description: Resizes the tensor implementation's size and optionally its strides for MPS.

methods.name: Tensor empty_mps(IntArrayRef size,std::optional<ScalarType> dtype_opt,std::optional<Layout> layout_opt,std::optional<Device> device_opt,std::optional<bool> pin_memory_opt,std::optional<c10::MemoryFormat> memory_format_opt)
methods.description: Creates a new empty tensor with specified size and optional parameters for the MPS backend.

methods.name: Tensor empty_strided_mps(IntArrayRef size,IntArrayRef stride,std::optional<ScalarType> dtype_opt,std::optional<Layout> layout_opt,std::optional<Device> device_opt,std::optional<bool> pin_memory_opt)
methods.description: Creates an empty tensor with specified size and stride, utilizing MPS backend.

methods.name: const Tensor & resize_mps_(const Tensor & self,IntArrayRef size,std::optional<MemoryFormat> optional_memory_format)
methods.description: Resizes an existing tensor in-place for the MPS backend, with optional memory format.

methods.name: Tensor & set_mps_(Tensor & result)
methods.description: Sets a tensor's storage to an empty MPS storage.

methods.name: Tensor & set_storage_mps_(Tensor & result,Storage storage,int64_t storage_offset,IntArrayRef size,IntArrayRef stride)
methods.description: Sets the storage of a tensor to a given MPS storage with specified offset, size, and stride.

methods.name: Tensor _efficientzerotensor_mps(IntArrayRef size,std::optional<ScalarType> dtype,std::optional<Layout> layout,std::optional<Device> device,std::optional<bool> pin_memory)
methods.description: Creates a zero-initialized tensor on MPS device with specified size and dtype.
